title: The map: back to the list
why: Jason, 2026-11-19: "no way for me to go back to the list i had before I click an item" (approved). A place's card opened above the list and jumped the panel to the top, its only way out a bare ×. Now an open card hides the list and leads with "← Back to the list (N)"; that, the × and Esc bring the list back where it was, the place opened marked; ‹ › still step; Esc with no card still leaves the map. Also a guard on a timer that ran after the map closed. js/map-view.js.
